title: P1 file.put: request metadata
description: File metadata, the binding passes the bytes. The core writes the file record (tenant, producer, class, deadline) and returns a file_ref with 128 random bits (ART-1, TEN-7). The lease token is not passed in the body: the holder sends it in the Botaru-Lease header (spec/bindings/http/README.md), one way for all operations under a lease (FEN-2).

data_mark.description: File mark; not lower than the task mark and not above what the uploader is allowed.
